name: Midoriya Tappei
source:
He is [url=http://vndb.org/c1872]Tatsuki's[/url] father and head of the Midoriya Group. He is an obstinate and domineering husband. A heavy drinker, like a true Tokyo-ite, who gives the impression of a true craftsman. While working outside he is a cheerful and playful old man. At 232 cm (~7′ 7″), he is considerably taller than Tatsuki, so much so that even socks don't fit him. He loves to smoke his pipe and is bad with machines. His wife bosses him around -- he is truly no match for her. He is a lover of both men and women, a bisexual DILF.''

[From [url=http://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Characters/Morenatsu]TV Tropes[/url]]
